| Bilinear | 22.28 | 25.48 |
| Malvar, He and Cutler | 26.26 | 15.98 |

The image of the figure, 240 by 120 pixels, through an RGGB mosaic and back. The PSNR compares all three channels with the original, without the 2 pixels next to the edge. The false color is the mean of |R - G| + |B - G| over the star, which is gray in the original, so every bit of it is an error.
